initial_direction_decision.idea: priority follows the current wait chain between page-table and payload service
initial_direction_decision.decision: archive broad priority-inheritance novelty claim; retain as baseline component
initial_direction_decision.because: US20140281081A1 (2014) Fig7–10 explicitly propagates QoS along blocked bus paths and lets the blocking lower-priority transaction inherit it. MASK §5.4 already always prioritizes translation and uses concurrent walks/stalled warps to choose data service. Generic dependence-based priority is not the new contribution.
initial_direction_decision.not_claimed: These sources do not by themselves establish the complete byte-range-scoped successful write-continuation mechanism.

positive_replacement.name: retain validated WRITE range until logical parent retirement
positive_replacement.problem: A bounded current physical-W debt does not bound the unread remainder of an already accepted long source AR. After physical null retirement, the source FIFO can fill and hold R while a fresh patch translation waits behind that same R. Correct physical W escape alone therefore need not restore logical progress.
positive_replacement.added_capability: Successful exact-range suffix repair can proceed without a new page-table read even after the original physical B has arrived and the ordinary shared translation cache entry has been evicted, provided the original write authorization remains valid for the logical operation.
rule: At original physical AW preparation, retain the validated destination PA range, relevant attributes/domain and original operation identity in a parent record; do not infer another request's permission from equal PA.
A repair must be a strict still-unwritten subrange of that same validated physical AW and preserve size/attributes; retain real source words and use original logical byte progress, not null-W count.
Null W retires only the physical owner. Original physical B settles in the parent record; authorization/PA and error state remain until all real bytes and all physical B responses complete.

Issue the repair through a physical path that actually bypasses a new IOMMU walk, coordinated with the pre-mux W-owner release. Reissuing virtual AW with a cached-looking hint does not provide this capability.

Only stable mapping/source, Normal DDR, no destination overlap, and fully independent peer completion are in the initial contract. Dynamic invalidation requires explicit revocation/drain integration; IOFENCE is not a job-completion fence.
If the platform cannot provide the retained authorization and physical replay path, reject this integration rather than assume free prep/PA or an externally reorderable MIG queue.
跨child继续同一个已接受source AR时，旧AW局部PA范围只能修复局部suffix；整段source-return envelope仍须被持续有效的WRITE许可覆盖。下一child若重新walk，也能重成heldR环。同4KiB页可计一个页级证书，多页须计多个记录或在合法AR首次VALID前切段。
complete_cost: Parent record must retain PA range, AXI attributes/domain identity, real-progress offset, physical-B/error state and authorization lifetime. Actual bits/ports and timing require a concrete design; these are not claimed free.
A pre-mux release and a post-translation replay must share a consistent parent/owner record and obey held VALID, same-ID order, exact physical LAST and one logical completion.
Charge replay AW/B, null beats and all jobs' ACK. Reusing original translation changes cost, so the ordinary controls receive the same retained range and state budget.
Every source AR's complete unreceived length and FIFO reservation are accounted separately from current physical AW debt; never equate them.

decisive_hand_counterexample.type: legal prospective interface state, not an observed platform trace
decisive_hand_counterexample.resources: A FIFO Q=3, B complete payload=3, single physical R/W lane, stable own mappings, A accepted source AR=24 words, current A physical AW covers first6 words
decisive_hand_counterexample.state: A has truly written first4 words; current physical AW debt q=2. A later source words arrive while fully resident and authorized B owns W; A FIFO fills with words5,6,7 and word8 is held RVALID. Original A null B may settle. A destination entry is allowed to be evicted before repair.
decisive_hand_counterexample.fresh_walk_control: If repair cannot issue until a fresh PTE response, that PTE may be queued behind held source word8. A cannot pop words5/6 until its repair AW is authorized; held R cannot disappear by changing request priority. Thus the stated finite-buffer return policy permits a circular wait.
decisive_hand_counterexample.retained_range_action: The original validated AW covers words1..6, so repair of words5..6 uses its retained PA range with no new PTE. Real W consumes words5/6 and releases FIFO slots; held source R can advance. This only removes this particular translation-return cycle, not every possible source/W scheduling cycle.
decisive_hand_counterexample.ordinary_strong_control: An ordinary prepare/commit controller retaining the same validated range and parent state can do this too. The counterexample proves a necessary capability for bounded speculative commitment, not unique algorithmic superiority.
decisive_hand_counterexample.limits: Actual current production bank read-admission and cross-bank W gates may forbid the initial peer state; introducing the capability requires checking the proposed B/C interface, not claiming a current board deadlock.
decisive_hand_counterexample.next_child_limit: repair5/6排空这一次FIFO后，不代表整个24-word job安全：后续child7..12若需新PTE且其源R占满FIFO，仍可同环；需要整个已accepted source AR return-envelope的许可连续覆盖。

second_decisive_scene.condition: No entry eviction and no held source R; all tail payload resident and translation hot
second_decisive_scene.prediction: Retained range cannot be credited with a miss reduction here; ordinary same-information preprepared patch can match the action. Metadata may cost more with no latency gain.

critical_source_review.fact: A first downstream AW offer pushes W ownership before a stalled AW handshake; W owner pops only on true physical WLAST. Thus post-IOMMU replay alone cannot release the original upstream owner.
Current owner read admission uses AW reservation/accepted ownership and restricts non-full-buffer bank reads. A hypothetical all-reads-open deadlock is not automatically production reachable.
Current control selects WRITE translation ahead of READ to open a W drain; raw virtual AW preparation and W-order claim are not presently independent APIs.
PTW AR id is fixed0, one-word request; the next PTE requires a real AR/R handshake. Held payload R can matter under a valid serialized shared-return implementation.
Current nonblock DMA0/1 use512-word buffers, other DMA use3. DS and comp are separate initiators; sharing downstream DDR is not sharing a byte-credit pool.
Comp/DS both feed the system fabric and common dram clock converter/MIG; internal MIG request selection cannot be replaced by the test C++ priority intervention.

TL internally retains req_data.did/bank/ttype and returns PA/range/R/W permissions; existing ATS request path is a distinct permission/configured mode. A prepare API can reuse internals, but cannot pretend the present DS id0 carries requester identity or blindly send an ATS request without its configuration and semantics.

Current completion uses saved translated PA and issues physical AW in COMPLETE, then returns IDLE on physical AW handshake; it is not an exposed parent-lifetime mapping lease or nonclaiming DMA WRITE-preparation API.

primary_sources.title: Cut and Forward: Safe and Secure Communication for FPGA System on Chips (TCAD/CASES2022)
primary_sources.established: Original AW buffered; fully resident C-word child writes pipelined; true child LAST releases W; merge physical B into one parent response. This is the concrete published resident-only baseline.
primary_sources.not_established: The read segment does not establish bounded nonresident WRITE commitment or normal-operation null-drain plus exact successful suffix repair. No author implementation was read in this stage.

innovation_judgment.because: The simple retained-range control also removes the hand-constructed cycle, and parent-aware replay is established, so retaining PA alone is a necessary architecture component rather than a proved independent scheduling innovation.
innovation_judgment.if: If bounded speculative commitment or nonclaiming WRITE preparation demonstrates a capability/resource point that complete ordinary controls do not match, and exact original-source review confirms an additional normal-operation capability, then the complete mechanism can form a narrow architecture contribution.
innovation_judgment.next: Integrate this requirement into B/C contribution cards before writing any model. Only after checking own permission, upstream W claim, current-AW versus long-source-R debt and actual replay path should a decisive real-iDMA case be specified.

root_b_mechanism_derivation.contract: aligned words, Q existing payload slots, r physically resident true words belong to this exact new child AW; freeze L before its first AWVALID and require 1≤L≤r+Q, r>0. Real W consumes r and additional arrivals once each; null does not consume engine data.
root_b_mechanism_derivation.proof: At any later source-starved W head, all initially r resident words must already have been truly consumed (otherwise head is not source-starved under ordered words). Hence current-child true debt q≤L−r≤Q. The accepted source AR can still have arbitrarily more words after this child; q is not its remaining length.
root_b_mechanism_derivation.strict_recourse_bound: If every resumed child advances at least1 real W before another null conversion, q strictly decreases; perchild conversions≤Q and null≤Q(Q+1)/2, physical AW including original≤Q+1. Across the full copy sum over children; cannot claim constant whole-job cost.
root_b_mechanism_derivation.normal_limit: r≤Q implies a child length≤2Q. With Q3 it is at most6 words, so long jobs require many children even without gaps. This gives a concrete speculative-debt/transaction-count tradeoff, not a one-AW long-job normal fastpath.
root_b_mechanism_derivation.baseline: Grant ordinary resident-prefix, dynamic tail and ordinary success-replay controls the same original validated range/metadata. Do not compare only against all-one-word writes or artificial from-alreadycommitted histories.
root_b_mechanism_derivation.status: root independent symbolic derivation; no model, no cycles or platform throughput claim
